proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.choice_restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing granted-spell surface can name a spell and its cast mode, but it cannot narrow the spell's own internal command/option vocabulary for casts made through the item.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_shape_override
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing granted-spell surface cannot override a granted spell's printed attachment/area header for item-specific casts such as a fixed cone size.

notes: The charge pool, fixed DC 15, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction all fit the existing magic-item surface. I did not author a content record because the spell restrictions cannot be represented honestly with the current grant_spell_access shape.
